references.observations: Municipal panorama: unequal open masonry arches, small true relief openings through the piers, varied stone courses and cutwaters; outer bays cross the dry bank path.
Tourism-office deck photo: warm narrow central paving, dark stone edge strips, low stone parapets with flat coping and repeated low rounded stone guards. No tall iron guardrail.

Christian Ferrer2016 river photo: pointed/segmental arch silhouettes, warm weathered masonry, relief openings, plain parapets and river-pier geometry. The hill/cathedral remains neighboring map context.
